days_meaning: each delivery day adds this much cash to your side

messages.text: Hola, Rival Plata, voy con prisa: 110 por La Dama de Serrano y cerramos ya. Entrega inmediata.
We can deliver La Dama de Serrano for 135 primas with 10 delivery days, a fair deal we're ready to sign.
Venga, 119; no tengo mucho tiempo. Entrega inmediata.
Happy to give you immediate delivery: 140 with 0 days and we can close.
128 y lo cerramos ahora. Entrega inmediata.
Let's meet at 135 with immediate delivery (0 days) and close it now.
